title: Wrapper Return
statement: Implement `solve(amount)`. A logging wrapper forwards `charge` to an inner client and records the amount. The inner client returns `ok:{amount}` for a positive int and `reject` otherwise. The wrapper must return that same result, not None, and include the amount in `seen` only when it forwarded. Return `{"result": ..., "seen": [...]}`. Always forward, including rejects, and record every forwarded amount.
constraints: The wrapper returns the inner result

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A wrapper that logs and forgets to return the inner result turns a successful charge into None.

editorial: A wrapper that logs and forgets to return the inner result turns a successful charge into None. The decorator-style object has one job besides the log line: pass the return value through. Recording the amount shows the forward happened.
